class: Informational accessibility guidance was classified as an error from the word unable
symptom: Verified submission was refused because a conditional notice explaining how to request a disability accommodation appeared in an alert region.
root_cause: The validator correctly inspected alert regions but treated unable as evidence of failure without distinguishing a conditional accommodation instruction from a reported validation error.
fix: Exclude a narrowly recognized conditional disability-accommodation notice, while preserving actual errors in separate alerts or within the same text.
prevention: Check the semantic purpose of an alert, not only error-like words, and always pair informational-alert regressions with real-error retention tests.
why_tests_missed: Existing tests covered success and route-announcement alerts but not conditional accommodation guidance containing the word unable.
